players.product: Chromium single-cell and Atera spatial biology platforms

quarterly_data.signal: Reported revenue was $151 million and adjusted revenue was $149.4 million, up 3%. Consumables grew 7%, spatial consumables grew 16% and gross margin was 74%; single-cell reaction volume grew at a double-digit rate.
quarterly_data.figure: adjusted revenue $149.4M (+3%); consumables +7%; spatial consumables +16%; GM 74%

quarterly_data.signal: Atera whole-transcriptome spatial orders were already well above the planned 40 shipments for 2026, with most shipments expected in the fourth quarter. Management estimated maximum annual consumable pull-through of $1.5-$3 million per instrument, about twice Xenium.

Flex Apex was positioned for large perturbation studies and the generation of training data for biological AI models. Full-year revenue guidance was $610-$630 million and cash and equivalents were $552 million.
